Delhi Police deny pellet gun use amid protest allegations

Delhi Police have denied using pellet guns against protesters marching towards Parliament. Allegations of their use have revived a debate on the legality and application of non-lethal weapons for crowd control in India. The controversy specifically involves the Rapid Action Force. The debate centers on the existing laws governing the dispersal of unlawful assemblies.
